title: Sanyuanli incident
text: The Sanyuanli incident was a military conflict between British troops and an irregular force made up of Chinese militia and local citizens that took place around Sanyuanli village on the outskirts of Canton on the 29 May 1841 after the Second Battle of Canton at the time of the First Opium War (1839–1842). Though it was a minor skirmish, in the centuries that followed the incident took on legendary proportions among the Chinese public. The Chinese government has erected several monuments to commemorate the legacy of the incident.
